text: ＊を　かわいがって　あげてね！

structure.jp: かわいがって　あげてね！

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.span: かわいがって　あげて
patterns.explanation: て-form plus あげる says you do something for someone's benefit. かわいがってあげて = 'give it love (for its sake)'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: A bare て-form with ね is a soft, friendly request. あげてね = 'please do it, okay?'
